title: Peanut butter fat bombs
summary: Salty-sweet peanut butter cups set in the freezer, with a thin cap of sugar-free dark chocolate.
steps: Line a 12-cup mini-muffin tin with paper cases, or use silicone moulds.
Warm the peanut butter and the ¼ cup coconut oil in a small pan over low heat, stirring, until smooth and pourable. Whisk in the powdered erythritol, vanilla and salt.
Spoon into the cases, filling each about two-thirds full, and freeze for 20 minutes until the surface is firm.
Melt the chocolate chips with the teaspoon of coconut oil in short bursts in the microwave or in a bowl over barely simmering water, stirring until smooth.
Spoon a thin layer of chocolate over each cup, tilting to cover the peanut layer, and freeze at least 30 minutes more.
tips: If your peanut butter is unsalted, add a few flakes of salt on the chocolate before it sets.

origin.history: Fat bombs are a modern invention of the low-carb and ketogenic diet community in the United States, spread largely through blogs and forums in the 2010s. This version imitates the American peanut butter cup, a candy that dates to the early twentieth century, but replaces the sugar with erythritol and much of the bulk with coconut oil.
